contexts.statement: Retrospective exploratory review of the September 24, 2026 retained-output rational Chow draft, not an audit of unattempted manuscript theorems.

definitions.X: smooth connected projective complex surface with chi(O_X)=1
definitions.C_*: literal relation.tex rel:fiber-contribution with ordinary codimension-two projection and expansion at x_1=x_2=0
definitions.selected coefficient: connected-output graph coefficient fixed before evaluation, not a uniquely recoverable coefficient on an individual surface

claims.natural_statement: For all n_1,n_2,p >= 0 and the stated line classes and weights, the literal fiber expression is c_*[Delta_X] plus external products of total codimension two in Q[1,K,c_2(T_X),L_1,L_2,T,H]; a fixed retained-output recursion selects c_* from the listed intersection data, with c_*=0 at n_1=n_2=0. Negative extracted m_i mean zero. This does not identify virtual fixed classes or prove Bloch conjecture.

The archived exact rational recursive and independent toric computations agree in the eight specified zero-line cases and the one specified nonzero projective-shift case on P^2; this is a finite experiment, not an arbitrary-length proof.

Universality of fully integrated numerical Hilbert-scheme invariants alone neither proves the retained-output Chow decomposition nor identifies its selected formal diagonal coefficient; on P^2 the diagonal is itself a sum of external products.

routes.retired_because: Numerical EGL universality integrates away both output factors and cannot choose a coefficient in a possibly nonunique diagonal decomposition; the marked recursion must precede numerical comparison. This records the established failed route, not a new attack.
